name: Koutiala

queries.query: Koutiala Mali cadastral map parcel cadastre official registry
queries.result: First-party discovery found Mali's Direction générale des Domaines et du Cadastre, its Koutiala bureau listing, the public NINACAD viewer, and an official Koutiala urban-planning map. No Koutiala parcel geometry was exposed by the public viewer routes inspected.

queries.query: Koutiala Mali géomètre cadastre parcelles carte site officiel
queries.result: La recherche de première partie a confirmé le Bureau des Domaines et du Cadastre de Koutiala et les règles nationales du cadastre, mais aucun service public anonyme de géométrie parcellaire pour Koutiala n'a été vérifié.
No additional first-party Koutiala parcel viewer or downloadable parcel geometry was found; the official DGDC/NINACAD sources above remain the relevant evidence.

registryEvidence.custodian: Direction générale des Domaines et du Cadastre du Mali, Bureau des Domaines et du Cadastre de Koutiala
registryEvidence.basis: The official DGDC regional/subregional services page explicitly lists BUREAU/KOUTIALA with a telephone number. This evidences a local cadastral custodian, not an open parcel dataset.

officialSources.observation: Current public NINACAD viewer shell; its JavaScript configuration points to the public API and GeoServer parcel service.
officialSources.scope: Public national NINACAD viewer; the current commune list includes Bamako, Kita, Koulikoro, Sikasso and Segou, but not Koutiala.

officialSources.observation: WFS capabilities expose layer sifMali:parcelle, EPSG:4326, and advertised WGS84 extent longitude -9.461653050247671 to -6.053873462910213; safe schema fields include uoid, numeroparc, ninacad, section, surface, perimetre and geom.
officialSources.scope: Advertised GeoServer layer extent does not reach Koutiala longitude -5.46304863912067; this is a service-extent limit, not evidence of citywide absence.

officialSources.observation: Official DGDC page describes commune/local/regional/national cadastral organization and unique parcel identification (NINACAD).
officialSources.scope: National cadastral policy and procedure; not an anonymous Koutiala geometry endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Officially hosted Koutiala urban-planning map/document with lot and planning geometry references.
officialSources.scope: Planning map for Koutiala and environs; not a parcel registry API or retained parcel sample.

requests.outcome: Fetched public viewer shell and identified current app bundle /assets/app-D5kMcntp.js.

Inspected current configuration: API base https://ninacad.sprdf.ml; GeoServer base https://geodata.sprdf.ml/geoserver/sifMali/ows; routes loadCommunes, LoadSectionByCommune, SeachParcel and InfosNinacad.
Returned the current public commune groups; Koutiala was not present. This is not treated as citywide absence.
Returned isSuccess=true with an empty item list; because Koutiala is not in the viewer commune list, no section lookup was qualified.
Returned WFS capabilities for sifMali:parcelle with EPSG:4326 and advertised extent not covering Koutiala.
Returned schema; safe field mapping recorded in service review only.
Returned an empty FeatureCollection (numberMatched=0, numberReturned=0) for the bounded 0.02-degree box around the exact WUP point; not treated as citywide absence and no sample was retained.

source: Mali DGDC / NINACAD public viewer and GeoServer WFS

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: National NINACAD viewer and DGDC cadastral system; local custodian at Koutiala is listed.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The inspected public parcel layer advertises an extent west of Koutiala and the viewer exposes no Koutiala commune/section entry; no Koutiala geometry was verified.

remainingUncertainty: A local DGDC Koutiala bureau is evidenced, but the current public NINACAD viewer and its advertised WFS coverage do not provide a verified Koutiala parcel ID-plus-geometry response. Exact-point/bounded-box absence and service extent were not generalized to citywide cadastral absence.
